name: sk-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Slovakia, tax year 2026, each rule tied to the Slovak law on slov-lex.sk. Covers the limited liability company (s.r.o.: EUR 5,000 capital, EUR 750 per member, 1 to 50 members, 30% of each cash contribution and EUR 2,500 in total paid before filing, full payment for a single founder), the joint-stock company (a.s., EUR 25,000), the simple joint-stock company (j.s.a., EUR 1), general and limited partnerships, founding documents (notarial deed, lawyer-authorised document or the simplified e-form), the bar on founders with tax or social insurance arrears, the 90-day filing window, registration under the new Commercial Register Act No. 29/2026 from 17 August 2026 (court or notary as registrar, 2 working days), the 2026 court fees for registration by the court (EUR 220 s.r.o., EUR 550 a.s., EUR 50 name reservation), and annual filing. Trigger phrases: set up an s.r.o., Slovak company formation, minimum capital Slovakia, obchodný register, zakladateľská
